g.text: Figure 4a-2 Activity Diagram — Fieldwork Execution and Feedback Loops
Per-procedure execution inside an A6 instance (engine split, validation, A7, Loop 1, auto-disposition, safe point) is Figure 4b (Member C)
Decide within the allowed set: confirm / override
manual result / not applicable / evidence unreliable
Present next ReviewTask by 9.1 tier with the decisions
allowed for its kind: reasoning chain, evidence,
dispute: A6 and A7 side by side no ranking,
failed / unattributed: rule result or failure reason,
structured payload, reason, empty reason rejected),
submit(ReviewRecord) via DecisionSubmit, log dwell time
P2 not settled: ReviewQueue publishes tasks?
plan vN approved, execution bound to vN
Target version current, gate state valid
and decision allowed for task kind?
Recompute Procedure status: completed only when every
ReviewTask of the procedure is decided, no open dispute,
no follow-up run pending and the period is covered
(timing != interim or periodCovered), otherwise it stays
awaiting_human / in_dispute, moves to executing, or
parks in interim_completed until its GEN-24 completes
A5 sends confirmation requests once at layer 0
reply received (A3 DOC-06), reminder timer, deadline timer
Schedule current layer: build DAG, topological
layers, group by cycle (cap 4), deterministic table,
procedures waiting for a confirmation event stay planned,
GEN-24 becomes ready when its interim procedure is
interim_completed, no dispatch while reassessment flag is raised
A6 instance fw-L-0: for each procedure
in subset run Figure 4b until subset
A6 instances fw-L-1 .. fw-L-k: same on
own subset, remainder of a failed
Fan-in: merge StatePatches by ID into EngagementState
ReviewTask drafts from the instances are published
to the queue here after validation,
auto-closed results do not enter the queue,
A1 recomputes Procedure status from Runs,
Validate target version and gate state
fraud trigger: GEN-16 discussion with governance first,
clear flag, re-assemble pack without data re-ingest
back to pack assembly in Figure 4a-1 (Member A)
Published ReviewTasks are handled by the review lane
in parallel (fork above), the layer loop does not wait
no open dispute, no confirmation pending,
no pending layer, no reassessment flag
A4 re-reasons on new evidence and rule summary:
rerun / manual result / not applicable / evidence unreliable
RCA; exchanges messages only with Concierge
A10; presents ReviewTasks, assigns manual tasks, collects decisions verbatim (form fallback: same fields)
A1 (scheduling, validation, persistence, events), A5 EvidenceAgent, RuleEngine; deterministic, no LLM
A4 RiskAssessor, A6 FieldworkAgent, A7 ReviewAgent
A10 builds GateDecision / ReviewRecord -> DecisionSubmit -> A1 validates target version and gate state -> writes
Procedure level, inside A6 instance, Figure 4b
Engagement level, flag at safe point, GATE-R approve / reject / withdraw, plan version +1
Any phase (Figure 3a): GateDecision.disposition = withdraw, workpapers sealed
A5 sends once and returns; replies and timers are events; only dependent procedures wait, fan-in and GATE-R do not
The ReviewTask lane runs as its own branch of the P2 fork; layer scheduling never waits for a human decision, the two lanes meet only at the pack settled condition
